channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: After a week of record hyperscaler backlogs, the weekend story was who pays for the buildings. The Wall Street Journal reported that CoreWeave, Nebius and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the high-yield bond market, with CoreWeave's 9.75% notes now trading above a 15% yield, Lambda cutting its target valuation from $14.5 billion to $13 billion, and Nscale's IPO leaning toward December. Where bonds will not go, vendors and banks are stepping in: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee billions of debt for the first 460 MW building of Nscale's West Virginia campus, which Anthropic has contracted for about $44.6 billion, and KB Kookmin Bank will arrange about 10.7 trillion won of loans secured on Naver Cloud's long-term GPU contract, Korea's first GPU financing. In hardware, Marvell agreed to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at $115 billion to combine electrical and optical interconnect. On the public tape all 70 list prints confirmed; Lambda H100 holds at $3.99 and B200 at $6.69 per GPU-hour.

item.title: Compute brief - 2 November 2026
item.description: After a week of record hyperscaler backlogs, the weekend story was who pays for the buildings. The Wall Street Journal reported that CoreWeave, Nebius and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the high-yield bond market, with CoreWeave's 9.75% notes now trading above a 15% yield, Lambda cutting its target valuation from $14.5 billion to $13 billion, and Nscale's IPO leaning toward December. Where bonds will not go, vendors and banks are stepping in: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee billions of debt for the first 460 MW building of Nscale's West Virginia campus, which Anthropic has contracted for about $44.6 billion, and KB Kookmin Bank will arrange about 10.7 trillion won of loans secured on Naver Cloud's long-term GPU contract, Korea's first GPU financing. In hardware, Marvell agreed to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at $115 billion to combine electrical and optical interconnect. On the public tape all 70 list prints confirmed; Lambda H100 holds at $3.99 and B200 at $6.69 per GPU-hour. Countries: South Korea: KB Kookmin leads about 10.7 trillion won of loans for Brookfield's GPU SPC supplying Naver Cloud; Samsung SDS breaks ground on 60 MW Gumi site (Wire, 1 and 2 Nov). United States: Nvidia in talks to guarantee debt for Nscale's 460 MW Anthropic building in West Virginia (Wire, 29 Oct, corroborated). United Kingdom: National Grid buys land at Teesworks for the UK's biggest substation, up to 3.2 GW per the mayor, next to a planned AI data centre (Wire, 1 Nov). Canada: Anthropic reportedly in lease talks for Beacon's Sturgeon County campus with an approved 920 MW gas plant (Wire, 30 Oct, single source). India: Vultr launches 20 MW, about 10,000 AMD MI355X GPUs in Chennai; targets 600 MW in India by 2028 (Wire, 2 Nov). Australia: Energy North drops the June 2028 first-power date for its 1 GW Project Ares after the NT regulator pauses review (Wire, 1 Nov, single source).
